extDescription.message: See Steam review scores ("Very Positive", "Mixed"…) on every store game without hovering. Dim, hide or outline games by score.

filter.description: Engraved plate label over the left lever. Keep short, uppercase if the language uses case.

highlight.description: Engraved plate label over the right lever.

dim.description: Switch option: darken games under the bar.

hide.description: Switch option: hide games under the bar.

off.description: Shown in the readout and engraved in the parking gate when a lever is parked.

judgedBy.description: Section title: which review score the levers look at.

myLanguage.description: Button: use the score from reviews in the user's Steam language.

allLanguages.description: Button and tooltip prefix: use the score from reviews in every language.

sourceLocalHint.message: Filter and highlight using only reviews in $LANG$. Games with no score in $LANG$ use all languages instead.
sourceLocalHint.description: Popup tooltip for the "My language" button. $LANG$ is the Steam language name.

sourceGlobalHint.message: Filter and highlight using reviews in every language.
sourceGlobalHint.description: Popup tooltip for the "All languages" button.

sourceLabelsNote.message: Labels show both scores when they differ.
sourceLabelsNote.description: Popup tooltip line: the store labels list both scores when they differ.

betweenTiers.description: Small note when a lever rests between two Steam labels.

leverFilterAria.message: Filter bar: games at this tier or lower are dimmed or hidden

leverHighlightAria.message: Highlight bar: games at or above this are outlined

modeAria.message: What to do with games under the filter bar

sourceAria.message: Which review score to judge by

tier1.description: Steam's review label. Use Steam's own translation for this label in this language.

rule1.description: Steam's rule for the label, very short.

notEnoughReviews.description: Badge text when Steam gives no label at all.

tooltip.message: $SCOPE$: $LABEL$ — $PCT$% of the $COUNT$ user reviews are positive
tooltip.description: Badge tooltip. SCOPE is 'All languages' or a language name, LABEL is Steam's label.

errOffline.message: Couldn't reach Steam. Showing what's already cached.
errOffline.description: Friendly error shown in the popup.

errRateLimited.message: Steam is rate-limiting requests. Retrying shortly.

errSteam.message: Steam returned an unexpected response. Some scores may be missing.

errNotStore.message: Open a Steam store page to see review scores.
errNotStore.description: Shown in the popup when the current tab is not the Steam store.
